subject: Insurance
title: Fat Tails and Extreme Events
description: Learn Fat Tails and Extreme Events in one minute.

hook.text: Normal distributions say extreme events are nearly impossible.

buildup.text: A 'fat tail' distribution has higher probability at the extremes.

discovery.text: Long-Term Capital Management used normal distributions in 1998.

twist.text: Insurers who underestimate tail risk go bankrupt.

climax.text: Fat tails warn that the worst-case scenario is more likely than you think.

punchline.text: 1-in-a-billion? It happens. Fat tails punish insurers who trust the bell curve.

quiz.question: What is a fat tail distribution?
options: A distribution where extreme events are more likely than expected
